messages:
Eli (Sales): Kicking off thread for StormBridge POC. They require SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning (bulk + deltas), RBAC with tenant admin delegation, wildcard domain proofing, and a Dedicated commit quote. Also sent a brief security questionnaire.
Priya (Solutions): Quick checklist: SAML cert rotation & signed metadata, SCIM delta support + throttling policy, RBAC role mapping + API for custom roles, domain verification (DNS TXT + ACME). Which are must-haves vs nice-to-haves?
Eli (Sales): Must-haves: SCIM delta + bulk onboarding (~2k users/week), wildcard subdomain verification, model access restrictions per tenant. KMS/HSM is an ask but may be negotiable.
Sam (SE): SCIM load: 2k/week ~= 300/day; spike/bootstrapping could hit thousands in a short window. Recommend Dedicated with burst capacity or Private if they insist on HSM. I'll prepare a sample SCIM load script and estimate QPS.
Marcus (Security): On security questionnaire: we are SOC2 Type II. Encryption at rest supported; Private supports customer-managed KMS/HSM. Dedicated can integrate KMS with entitlements and contract. Audit logs: default 90d retention, adjustable. SAML: we verify signatures and support encrypted assertions.
Priya (Solutions): RBAC approach: provide role templates (owner/editor/viewer), support custom roles via API, and enforce model-level policies at route layer. Example policy snippet included in runbook.
Eli (Sales): Pricing: they want a monthly Dedicated commit + ability to burst to hosted pool. Can we offer a base commit for 2x A10G-equivalents and burst at premium overage?
Sam (SE): Yes. I'll draft a blended quote (commit + overage per token) but need their expected peak RPS and average token/sec.
Eli (Sales): I'll ask StormBridge for traffic profile and confirm the HSM requirement.
Marcus (Security): Note: if they require HSM for Dedicated without an enterprise contract we need legal signoff. Flagging as potential blocker.
Priya (Solutions): Proposed 2-week POC: week 1 connect SAML + SCIM (ingest 500 test users), validate domain verification (DNS TXT + ACME); week 2 RBAC testing and perf/cost telemetry. SE + Security to join day-1.
Sam (SE): I can take Tue 10am PST for day-1. I'll post SCIM harness: https://internal.tools/scim-harness/stormbridge (draft).
ProvisionBot: Created POC workspace: stormbridge-poc (tagged).
Eli (Sales): Action items: Eli 5 request traffic/profile and HSM priority; Sam 5 sample SCIM harness + quote draft; Priya 5 runbook; Marcus 5 questionnaire answers + SOC2 link. Reconvene after drafts. :thumbsup:
Priya (Solutions): FYI: for wildcard subdomains we recommend DNS TXT org-level claim; ACME OK for single domains. Will document both in runbook and include enforcement notes for tenant isolation.
Marcus (Security): Uploaded draft responses to /docs/security/stormbridge-sq-3112233445.pdf.
Eli (Sales): Thanks team. I'll follow up with StormBridge and update thread when they reply.
